chain.label: FAA exempts commercial balloon pilots from medical certification
chain.trigger: 14 CFR 61.23(b) exempts balloon pilots from all medical certificate requirements

chain.label: Uncontrolled depression and ADHD plus therapeutic levels of multiple CNS-impairing medications
chain.trigger: the pilot had been diagnosed with medical conditions, including depression and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder... medications were found in the pilot's system that are known to cause impairment and are listed on the FAA's 'Do Not Issue' and 'Do Not Fly' lists

caused_by.evidence: the FAA's exemption of balloon pilots from medical certification requirements eliminated the potential opportunity for (1) an AME to identify the pilot's potentially impairing medical conditions and medications

chain.label: Degraded cognition and decision-making capacity
chain.trigger: depression, ADHD, and the combined effects of multiple CNS-impairing drugs likely affected the pilot's ability to make safe decisions

caused_by.evidence: These drugs degrade multiple psychomotor and cognitive skills including, but not limited to, vigilance and decision-making. When used in combination, the CNS depressant effect of any single drug can be exacerbated.

chain.label: Fog forming after sunrise and lowering ceilings along the route
chain.trigger: at 0646... 2 statute miles visibility, mist, a broken ceiling at 700 ft agl, temperature 23°C, dew point 23°C

chain.label: Pilot did not obtain the updated preflight observations and forecasts showing deterioration
chain.trigger: The pilot did not check weather again before launch; updated observations and forecasts available at that time indicated deteriorating conditions.

caused_by.evidence: Medical conditions and their treating medications not only impair aeronautical decision-making, as discussed previously, but also affect all decision-making.

chain.label: Decision to launch despite observed fog and a 1°C temperature/dew point spread
chain.trigger: the pilot's failure to obtain updated weather information denied him information that indicated conditions were deteriorating and might not remain VFR, which resulted in his decision to launch when he should have cancelled

caused_by.evidence: If the pilot had sought updated weather information just before launch, he might have recognized that conditions for the area were not suitable for flight
sufficient information was available (observed fog and a temperature/dew point spread of 1oC) to anticipate that conditions might deteriorate
The pilot demonstrated poor and potentially impaired decision-making when he decided to fly the balloon when forecast weather was unfavorable for VFR flight

chain.label: Continued flight in and out of clouds and climbed above the overcast rather than landing while the ground was visible
chain.trigger: instead of selecting a suitable landing location while still in visual contact with the ground, the pilot continued the flight, flying in and out of clouds and decreased visibility conditions until climbing above the clouds

caused_by.evidence: The balloon launched about 0658, and the ground crew stated that they watched the balloon fly in and out of the clouds
Fog and low clouds were visible from the balloon along the flight route within minutes of launch.
he decided to continue the flight when actual conditions included ground fog and clouds, and... he decided to fly above the clouds

chain.label: Descent to land through or near clouds in reduced visibility
chain.trigger: once above clouds that obstructed the view of the ground, the pilot decided to land in reduced visibility conditions that diminished his ability to see and avoid obstacles

caused_by.evidence: The pilot's earlier decision to climb above the clouds led to his subsequent decision to descend the balloon through, or very near to, clouds that obscured potential obstacles along the balloon's descent path.
Given the pilot's poor decision-making, the NTSB examined how his medical conditions may have affected his decision-making ability.

chain.label: High-voltage power lines crossing the flightpath, obscured by the cloud layer
chain.trigger: The crash site was located about 8 miles north of the launch site in an open field crossed by power lines... nearly perpendicular to the balloon's flightpath

caused_by.evidence: Because of the clouds, towers and, to an even greater degree, power lines would be difficult for the pilot to see as he descended.

chain.label: Balloon struck the power lines during descent
chain.trigger: Data from Hot Air, the navigation application on the pilot's tablet, indicated that the balloon's flightpath intersected power lines about 0742; the power line operator reported a power trip on the line at that same time.

caused_by.evidence: the pilot's decision to land in reduced visibility conditions that diminished his ability to see and avoid obstacles resulted in the balloon impacting power lines
the balloon impacting power lines that were obscured by low clouds and/or fog

chain.label: Basket separated, fuel released and ignited, basket fell about 100 ft to the ground
chain.trigger: the balloon's support cables struck power lines, causing separation of the basket from the envelope and burner assembly, the release of fuel, and the subsequent fire and ground impact

caused_by.evidence: severing enough of the support cables to separate the basket from the burner support frame and envelope... allowing liquid propane to spray from the severed lines, igniting a fire

chain.label: Pilot and 15 passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and 15 passengers all received fatal injuries. Autopsy results indicated the causes of death for the occupants included various combinations of blunt force trauma, thermal burns, and inhalation injuries.

caused_by.evidence: the balloon was destroyed by impact forces and postcrash fire
